why_seated: Thucydides is the other half of the null's classical-prose pole and has the lowest within-author dispersion measured in this work (0.0097 across eight books). Book V.84-116, the Melian dialogue, is also a rare case of sustained dialogue form inside a historian, which makes him usable as a genre control in ways the register has not yet exploited.
locus_note: Declared loci were verified by stem search against the seated text before being declared. An initial probe on ἐπιτάφ- returned zero and was replaced rather than asserted: the Funeral Oration is present but the modern section-title term is not in the text.
